tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Returns every join type, key matching mode, conflict strategy and fan-out mode this server supports, the fields it adds to each row, and the input and output row limits per call. Free, processes no data.

tools.name: join_rows
tools.description: Joins two lists of JSON rows on a shared key, like a SQL join or a spreadsheet VLOOKUP, and returns the combined rows plus a summary: how many rows matched on each side, match rates, and warnings for duplicate keys, rows missing the key and key fields that exist on no row. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: join_rows · Public sink: join_rows.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: join_rows · Public sink: join_rows

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
